datasets.name: esol
datasets.title: ESOL / Delaney aqueous solubility
datasets.target_column: measured log solubility in mols per litre
datasets.source: MoleculeNet (DeepChem mirror of the Delaney 2004 solubility set)
datasets.citation: Delaney, J. S. (2004) ESOL: Estimating Aqueous Solubility Directly from Molecular Structure. J. Chem. Inf. Comput. Sci. 44(3):1000-1005. Packaged by Wu et al. (2018), MoleculeNet, Chem. Sci. 9:513-530.
datasets.license: Public research data redistributed by the MoleculeNet authors; cite Delaney 2004 and Wu et al. 2018.
datasets.notes: 1128 drug-like molecules with measured aqueous solubility. Ships in the repo so training is reproducible offline.

datasets.name: bace
datasets.title: BACE-1 inhibition (MoleculeNet)
datasets.source: MoleculeNet (DeepChem) BACE dataset, slimmed to smiles/label/pIC50
datasets.citation: Subramanian et al. (2016) Computational modeling of beta-secretase 1 (BACE-1) inhibitors. Packaged by Wu et al. (2018), MoleculeNet, Chem. Sci. 9:513-530.
datasets.license: Public research data redistributed by the MoleculeNet authors; cite Subramanian et al. 2016 and Wu et al. 2018.
datasets.notes: 1513 compounds with binary BACE-1 inhibition labels. The 588 fingerprint columns of the original file were dropped; only smiles, label and pIC50 are kept.

datasets.name: qm7
datasets.title: QM7 atomisation energies
datasets.citation: Blum & Reymond (2009) 970 million druglike small molecules. Packaged by Wu et al. (2018), MoleculeNet, Chem. Sci. 9:513-530.
datasets.license: Public research data redistributed by the MoleculeNet authors.
datasets.notes: Not committed (larger file). Fetch with `python scripts/fetch_datasets.py --fetch qm7`.

kaggle.note: Kaggle datasets are supported through the official Kaggle CLI, which needs your own API token (~/.kaggle/kaggle.json). The sandbox this repo was built in cannot reach kaggle.com, so no Kaggle data is bundled.
usage: create an API token at https://www.kaggle.com/settings -> API -> Create New Token, save it to ~/.kaggle/kaggle.json
python scripts/fetch_datasets.py --kaggle-search chembl      # find a dataset slug
